name: cover-edit
description: Spec-first multi-platform content packaging studio for covers and articles.

scripts.smoke:render: node bin/cover-edit.mjs render --spec examples/specs/fundraising.json --target x-post --out dist/smoke/x-post.png
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && node bin/cover-edit.mjs validate --spec examples/specs/fundraising.json --all && node bin/cover-edit.mjs bundle --spec examples/specs/fundraising.json --out-dir dist/ci
